items.title: The henselization of a pair is flat and does not change the quotients by powers of the ideal
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma collects the flatness and the quotient behaviour of the henselization of a pair. The proof reads both statements off the construction of the henselization as a filtered colimit of etale algebras which induce isomorphisms modulo the ideal: flatness follows because etale maps are flat and flatness is preserved by filtered colimits, and the isomorphism statement follows by applying the same quotient-compatibility to each stage and passing to the colimit.
